headline: All Time Plastics submits depository compliance certificate to NSE
hook: Routine regulatory filing by All Time Plastics
summary: All Time Plastics Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 to the exchange. This is a routine corporate governance filing required for listed entities. The document confirms proper maintenance of depository records. Retail investors have no direct financial impact from this administrative filing.
why_it_matters: No direct financial consequence for retail investors
